title: Assign Cookies - Solution
intuition: Assign cookies to children greedily to maximize content children count. Each child has greed value, each cookie has size.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
time_complexity: O(n log n + m log m)
common_mistakes: Sort both children greed values and cookie sizes. Iterate with two pointers greedily matching smallest cookie satisfying next smallest greed value.
